items.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
items.summary: Mechanist is an autonomous agentic system that uses AI to discover and control the mechanisms underlying model intelligence, generating hypotheses, performing causal interventions, and improving safety and performance.

items.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
items.summary: Agentic systems can achieve open-ended improvement through multi-component co-evolution that progressively removes fixed human constraints across agents, environments, and evolution mechanisms.

items.title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
items.summary: SHAPER is a train-free framework that improves embodied agents by evolving reusable skills and a context-code harness around a frozen foundation model through environment rollouts.

items.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
items.summary: Genesis organizes long-horizon software development around a persistent project rather than persistent agents, enabling multi-day compiler construction and numerical module reimplementation with low cost and high performance.

items.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
items.summary: Agent safety should be enforced at runtime through preventive controls and verifiable evidence rather than relying solely on training-time alignment methods.

items.title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents
items.summary: ToolHazard is a scalable framework that synthesizes adversarial environments to test LLM agents against indirect prompt injections, revealing vulnerabilities and improving defensive alignment.

items.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
items.summary: Combodied Agents integrate digital and embodied tools into a closed-loop framework that models individual human-state trajectories over time to provide proportionate, consent-aware support.

items.title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
items.summary: SkillZip compresses self-evolving agent skills by finding a minimal faithful structural explanation that shares repeated rules and procedures while preserving rare exceptions, without requiring evaluation rollouts.

items.title: DSAgentBench: Can Agents Automate End-to-End Data-Science Workflows in Real Computer Environments?
items.summary: DSAgentBench evaluates autonomous agents on complete, multi-tool data-science workflows in real computing environments and reveals major performance gaps.

items.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
items.summary: A new benchmark called VibeLifeBench evaluates long-horizon proactive agents across simulated multi-week everyday tasks, revealing that current frontier models perform poorly.

items.title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
items.summary: Mendel Gödel Machine improves self-improving coding agents by using multi-trajectory mutations and cross-lineage hybridization to accelerate convergence and boost performance.

items.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
items.summary: Parameter-space exploration via perturbed policy sampling improves LLM reinforcement learning by diversifying rollouts and reducing training failures compared to action-space methods.

items.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
items.summary: OpenART introduces a scalable red-teaming arena with evolving stateful environments to evaluate long-horizon AI agent safety, using the EMHA attack policy to expose increasing failure rates as task complexity grows.

items.title: AtlasVLA: Persistent World-Ego State Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: AtlasVLA improves embodied AI by replacing reactive control with proactive reasoning via persistent world-ego memory, enabling robust long-horizon manipulation from a single wrist camera.

items.title: The Illusion of Visual Tool-Use: A Causal Audit of Thinking with Images
items.summary: Visual tool-use in multimodal LLMs often lacks causal effectiveness, with returned observations frequently failing to influence answers or being used incoherently despite aggregate accuracy improvements.

items.title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
items.summary: Stronger models can build inference-time harnesses that substantially improve weaker models' task performance without parameter updates by offloading reasoning into structured code and routing.

items.title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
items.summary: Spark-to-Paper is a lightweight, composable workflow inside coding assistants that generates research papers by separating planning from reporting, enforcing evidence-based claim revision, and using integrity checks to reduce fabrication.

items.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
items.summary: A new attention mechanism replaces fixed scaled dot-product attention with a learned power-law bilinear operator, with verified architecture, measured stability, and machine-checked proofs.

items.title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents
items.summary: A new photorealistic urban benchmark reveals large performance gaps for embodied agents in city-scale navigation and spatial reasoning.

items.title: Ex-Omni-2D: Expressive Omni-Modal Dialogue Models with Native Visual Presence
items.summary: Ex-Omni-2D is an omni-modal dialogue framework that produces coordinated text, speech, and video responses via a visual thought plan and a distilled streaming video generator.

items.title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds
items.summary: Latent-to-4D enables reusable direct 4D generation from video diffusion latents via alignment with a pretrained decoder and spatiotemporal attention, transferring across generators without retraining.

items.title: The Next Screenshot Knows: Gated Hindsight Distillation for Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Gated Hindsight Distillation improves GUI agent training by using future screenshots as privileged evidence to recover correct reasoning when standard imitation fails.

items.title: Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers
items.summary: SiPE integrates a lightweight syntactic prior from dependency parses into positional embeddings across transformer architectures, improving syntactic generalization and language understanding without altering self-attention or increasing inference cost.

items.title: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
items.summary: SkillZip compresses reusable procedural skills into contract-preserving, executable graph units to enable efficient retrieval and expansion under limited context budgets.

items.title: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling: Simulating Large LLM-Agent Societies on a Laptop
items.summary: Replacing individual LLM agents with low-parameter surrogates fitted from cheap queries enables scalable society simulations, with validity predicted by an interaction-order and memory taxonomy.

items.title: From Synthesis to Removal: Physics-Grounded Reflection Simulation and Diffusion-Based Video Dereflection
items.summary: A closed-loop framework combining physics-based video synthesis, diffusion-based video dereflection, and a new benchmark achieves state-of-the-art video reflection removal with fast inference.

items.title: AVA-Encoder: Towards Agent-Native Video Representation Learning
items.summary: AVA-Encoder learns structured video representations via agentic auto-encoding using knowledge graphs to enable cinematic video generation and reasoning with reduced token usage.

items.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
items.summary: InSight-doc adaptively allocates visual resolution during reasoning to improve long-document understanding while reducing latency and hallucinations.

items.title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
items.summary: Decoding-Level Taboo is a runtime logit-space stress test that reveals how large language models handle off-nominal generation paths, showing that robustness depends on scale and instruction alignment.

items.title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
items.summary: A rest-state framework reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration by fusing vision-language outputs into consistent part meshes and validating synthesized motion hypotheses via geometric consistency.

items.title: Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents
items.summary: Pruning strategies applied at different pipeline stages reduce token usage and latency in long-horizon research agents, with early pruning yielding the greatest efficiency gains.

items.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
items.summary: Open multilingual translation models are improved via group relative policy optimization with reference-free quality rewards and checkpoint interpolation, surpassing strong open and proprietary baselines.

items.title: JigShape: Evaluating Visual-Geometric Reasoning in VLMs through Jigsaw Puzzles
items.summary: A new jigsaw benchmark with interlocking pieces reveals that vision-language models fail at geometric reasoning and suffer a sharp performance drop as puzzle size increases.

items.title: Simplex Relaxation for Discrete Diffusion
items.summary: Simplax enriches uniform discrete diffusion via Dirichlet-categorical augmentation to improve reverse sampling and generative quality on text and Sudoku tasks.

items.title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs
items.summary: NeuPAT selectively constrains updates to language-sensitive neurons during multimodal tuning to preserve LLM language capabilities while enabling perceptual adaptation.

items.title: MBA: Multimodal Benchmark and Agents for Real-World Business Ideation
items.summary: Researchers introduce MBA-Bench, a multimodal benchmark for business ideation agents, and propose MBA-b and MBA-k models trained with creativity and feasibility rewards via LoRA fine-tuning and group relative policy optimization, significantly outperforming text-only and multimodal baselines.

items.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
items.summary: The benchmark evaluates autonomous coding agents on open-ended world-model research by having them iteratively improve a starter model across game environments using a shared structured-state format.

items.title: StateFlow: Building, Evolving, and Accessing 3D World States for Previsualization
items.summary: StateFlow introduces a persistent 3D world state to enable iterative, controllable previsualization for film and game design by constructing, evolving, and accessing structured scene and camera representations.

items.title: DistilVDR: A Compact End-to-End Visual Document Retriever via Dual-Student Distillation
items.summary: DistilVDR is a compact 524M vision-document retriever distilled from an 8B teacher using cosine alignment without relevance labels, achieving near-teacher accuracy with far smaller indexes and faster indexing.

items.title: AdvFD: Boosting Visual Generation via Adversarial Fr'echet Distance Loss
items.summary: Adversarial Fréchet Distance improves generator post-training by adding a learnable adversarial feature space to static Fréchet losses, with whitening to stabilize optimization.

items.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information
items.summary: SPIEval benchmarks mobile assistant LLMs on scattered personal data tasks, revealing major gaps in information retrieval and verification.

items.title: Self-Geometry: GT-Free and Plug-and-Play Test-Time Adaptation for Geometrically Consistent 3D Vision Foundation Models
items.summary: Self-Geometry improves vision foundation model predictions by enforcing explicit multi-view geometric constraints via test-time adaptation with LoRA, disentangled losses, and angular neighbor sampling.

items.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
items.summary: The study introduces a benchmark and formalizes narrative commitment preservation to evaluate long-horizon logical consistency in interactive storytelling with large language models.

items.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
items.summary: CoinRAG improves retrieval-augmented generation efficiency and accuracy by reusing fine-grained semantic nugget caches instead of full chunks.

items.title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
items.summary: UniMoMo compresses trained recommendation mixture-of-experts models into smaller standard MoE checkpoints via functional similarity grouping and layer-adaptive protection, preserving accuracy while accelerating inference.

items.title: Ready Cohorts: Bounding GPU Opportunity and Avoiding Host Round Trips in LLM-Agent Control
items.summary: Two studies define measurable GPU control gates for LLM-agent services by analyzing concurrent cohort scheduling and on-device routing versus host redispatch.

items.title: iFAN: Inference-Aware Learning for Plain Mask Transformers
items.summary: A training framework called iFAN improves mask transformers by aligning query ranking with mask quality and distilling stronger intermediate predictions to the final layer.

items.title: VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use
items.summary: A sub-2B Spanish cybersecurity vision-language model couples a frozen SigLIP encoder to a Spanish decoder via an MLP, introduces a NoPE positional-encoding ablation for visual attention, and reports near-zero visual grounding despite functional pipelines, with open-source weights and remediation plans.

items.title: Hand Visibility Detector: Per-Keypoint Visibility Estimation for Hands
items.summary: This work introduces a dedicated model for per-joint hand visibility estimation and demonstrates its benefit for multi-view 3D hand pose annotation.

items.title: TSDS-Toolbox: A Toolbox for Measuring Time-Series Dataset Similarity
items.summary: A unified toolbox enables reproducible comparison and extension of time-series dataset similarity methods for forecasting, classification, and generation tasks.
